Job Overview:

1st Shift

Schedule:

Primarily work Monday to Friday, with opportunities for overtime on weekends or beyond if necessary

Hours:

6:00am-2:30pm

With expertise in using material handling equipment like forklifts and pallet jacks, the General Warehouse Laborer is equipped to move, load, and unload materials throughout the facility and surrounding area.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Select vending and cold drink equipment that can effectively serve the sales requests.
  • It's crucial to utilize protective wrapping and attach the proper documentation (STO) to guarantee the safety and security of all outbound loads.
  • Follow CCCI's SOPs when aiding in the loading and unloading of trailers to assist with delivery operations. Use handhelds to update SAP and CONA, keeping track of inbound and outbound loads to ensure accuracy and accountability for the territories served by the Regional Operation Center.
  • Emphasize safety and cleanliness by completing all necessary pre- and post-trip evaluations, double-checking daily documentation for accuracy, and ensuring a tidy and obstacle-free work area.
  • Participate in various duties as directed, such as staging equipment and managing yard work, such as removing clutter and maintaining a neat appearance.
  • Use a switching system to move pup and 53' trailers to the docking location as needed.

There are certain traits that individuals must possess in order to be successful in their professional role. These traits are often referred to as knowledge, skills, and abilities, or KSAs

  • Proficient understanding of essential safety principles, including proper lifting methods and the adoption of personal safety clothing.
  • Possess expert-level forklift skills required to operate single-wide forklifts with finesse and accuracy.
  • Basic pallet-jack skills.
  • Elementary competence in mechanics and uncomplicated employment of tools.
  • Knowledgeable in handling different rudimentary machines.
  • Following written guidelines or instructions is essential for best practices.
  • Generate reports through handwritten or computer-based formats to track progress.
  • Follow verbal instructions.
  • Intermediate math skills.
  • A holistic understanding of the aspects that bolster productivity.
  • The ability to analyze the process of order building, optimize the loading workflow, and select the most efficient pick and load path.
  • Managing various processes at the same time is a fundamental part of maintaining an optimized system.
  • The skill of consistently counting incoming products and verifying them against the manifest is critical.
  • Consistently achieving accurate loading of trucks while following documentation requirements.
  • Exhibits superior interpersonal communication skills.
  • The job necessitates the ability to perform in extreme temperatures, noisy surroundings, slippery floors, and hazardous shards of glass.
  • Every once in a while, the requirement may arise to lift weights that exceed 25 pounds, although the frequency of such cases is low.
  • The capacity to remain seated for extended periods.
  • Regular movements on and off a forklift.
  • The opening and closing of truck dock doors play an essential role in the unloading and loading process.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Certification for forklift and pallet jack operation includes both theoretical and practical training to ensure safety and efficiency.
  • Switcher operation certification.
  • Obtaining a Class A commercial driver's license is mandatory in some cases.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Past familiarity with logistics handling.
  • It is critical to adhere to federal and state weight limitations to avoid fines and citations. Failing to comply with regulations can also lead to accidents and damage to the truck, trailer, and cargo.

Work Environment:

  • An environment that is both loud and lacks temperature regulation, varying between both high and low degrees.

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate – Picking, Packing & Fulfillment
jobs.description:
Warehouse Associate – Picking, Packing & Fulfillment

Alice & Wonder | Chicago, IL 60642
Starting at $17.50/hour

About the Role

Alice & Wonder is looking for a dependable, detail-oriented Warehouse Associate to join our Chicago warehouse team.

This position is primarily responsible for picking, packing, tagging, and preparing merchandise for our retail stores and online customers.

We're looking for someone who works efficiently, pays attention to the little details, and enjoys being part of a fast-moving team. You'll spend your day working with our products—picking merchandise, tagging clothing, preparing store transfers, packing online orders, checking product quality, and making sure orders leave our warehouse accurately and looking great.

Accuracy and productivity are the two biggest priorities in this role.

What You'll Do

Picking, Packing & Store Fulfillment

  • Pick merchandise accurately for store transfers and customer orders
  • Scan, pack, and prepare inventory transfers for our retail locations
  • Verify styles, sizes, colors, and quantities before orders are completed
  • Keep orders organized throughout the fulfillment process
  • Help ensure stores receive the right merchandise on time

Online Order Fulfillment

  • Pick and pack online customer orders accurately and efficiently
  • Inspect merchandise before packing to ensure it meets our quality standards
  • Prepare packages for shipment
  • Make sure orders are neat, accurate, and presentation-ready
  • Gift-wrap customer orders when requested

Tagging & Product Preparation

  • Tag and label clothing, accessories, and other incoming merchandise
  • Prepare new merchandise so it is ready for our stores and customers
  • Organize product by style, size, or designated inventory location
  • Identify damaged, defective, or incorrect merchandise
  • Communicate product or inventory discrepancies to the Warehouse Lead

Warehouse Support

  • Help count and verify incoming merchandise
  • Assist with inventory counts as needed
  • Restock and organize picking and packing areas
  • Keep your workstation and surrounding warehouse areas clean and organized
  • Work closely with warehouse, shipping, retail, and other teams
  • Pitch in with other warehouse tasks when needed

What We're Looking For

You could be a great fit if you:

  • Are dependable and consistently show up on time
  • Have strong attention to detail
  • Can work quickly without sacrificing accuracy
  • Are organized and like keeping things in the right place
  • Are comfortable working on your feet throughout your shift
  • Can follow established processes and instructions
  • Work well independently and as part of a team
  • Are comfortable doing repetitive tasks such as picking, packing, folding, tagging, and labeling merchandise
  • Take pride in sending out an accurate, well-presented order
  • Bring a positive attitude and are willing to help wherever needed

Previous retail, warehouse, inventory, stockroom, picking/packing, or fulfillment experience is helpful, but not required. We're happy to train the right person who is dependable, motivated, and willing to learn.

Physical Requirements

This is an active warehouse position that requires standing and moving throughout the workday.

The position regularly requires:

  • Standing and walking for extended periods
  • Bending, reaching, and moving around warehouse work areas
  • Picking merchandise from inventory locations
  • Packing, folding, tagging, and handling merchandise throughout the day
  • Lifting and carrying boxes weighing up to 40 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation

What Success Looks Like

Get the orders right and get them done.

Our stores receive the correct merchandise. Online customers receive the correct orders. Clothing gets tagged properly. Product is checked before it leaves the warehouse. Orders are completed efficiently, accurately, and on time.

You're someone the team can depend on to consistently get the details right.

About Alice & Wonder

Alice & Wonder is a Chicago-based retail company offering fun, unique, and affordable apparel, accessories, gifts, and more.

We're a growing local business with a hardworking, team-oriented environment. We move quickly, help each other out, and believe you can get a lot done while still having fun at work.

We're looking for people who want to be part of the team and contribute to what we're building.

What We Offer

  • Paid time off
  • Paid sick time
  • 401(k) with company matching
  • Fun, energetic work atmosphere
  • Team-oriented environment
  • Opportunity to learn different parts of a growing retail business
  • Employee growth opportunities

If you're organized, dependable, detail-oriented, and enjoy getting things done, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: From $17.50 per hour

Benefits:

  • 401(k)
  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental insurance
  • Employee discount
  • Flexible schedule
  • Health insurance
  • Health savings account
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

  • Are you able to stand and move throughout an 8-hour shift and lift/carry items weighing up to 40 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation?
  • Are you comfortable performing repetitive warehouse tasks such as picking orders, packing boxes, tagging clothing, folding merchandise, and preparing store transfers throughout your shift?
  • How many years of experience do you have in warehouse, retail stockroom, inventory, picking/packing, or order fulfillment?
  • Tell us about a job, school, or other experience where accuracy and attention to detail were important. What did you do to make sure your work was correct?

Work Location: In person

From your PASSION to ours

Lactalis USA, part of the Lactalis family of companies, is currently hiring a Sr. Analyst, Warehouse Management Systems based in Chicago, IL. The role includes working on Functional, technical specifications, interfaces, APIs, data mapping, reporting, troubleshooting, and integration with SAP Inventory Management, Materials Management, Sales/Distribution, Transportation, and Manufacturing processes. Additionally, the Technical Analyst will collaborate with functional analysts, business stakeholders, IT integration teams, and external partners to deliver stable, scalable solutions aligned with company goals and values.

Requirements

From your EXPERTISE to ours

Key Responsibilities For This Position Include

  • Strong hands-on Blue Yonder WM technical experience primarily in “Warehouse Management and Supply Chain Execution” processes.
  • Experience in integrating ERP/Host systems with Blue Yonder’s Warehouse Management Systems
  • Partner with functional analysts and business users to understand requirements and translate them into clear technical specifications and solution designs.
  • Develop, support, and troubleshoot technical objects such as interfaces, reports, conversions, enhancements, forms, workflows, integrations, and data extracts related to Blue Yonder WM.
  • Support system integrations between Blue Yonder WM to SAP ECC, middleware(Go Anywhere), EDI, APIs transportation, manufacturing, and third-party logistics applications.
  • Analyze BY interface failures, application errors, data mapping issues, transaction processing defects, and performance bottlenecks; document root cause and corrective actions.
  • Support API usage, testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting for inbound, outbound, and internal warehouse processes.
  • Participate in system configuration reviews, technical impact assessments, design walkthroughs, unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, and deployment readiness activities.
  • Prepare and maintain technical design documents, interface mapping documents, test evidence, cutover tasks, deployment checklists, and production support knowledge articles.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional IT teams, business process owners, and project teams to resolve integration and application issues.
  • Support large-scale BY WMS implementations, upgrades, enhancements, and legacy WMS replacement initiatives.
  • Ensure technical solutions follow IT standards for documentation, controls, security, scalability, maintainability, and operational support.
  • Provide hypercare and production support for Blue Yonder WM incidents, enhancement requests, and operational issues.
  • Comfortable working alongside business analysts and functional teams who provide requirements.
  • Experience with using / Testing APIs.
  • Experience in working with Native SaaS WMS solutions.
  • Minimum 2 years' experience working within Blue Yoder’s Warehouse Management Systems either as a customer of Blue Yonder or as a consultant implementing Blue Yonder solutions for customers.
  • Additionally relevant solutions consulting and implementation experience with other leading supply chain planning solutions such as SAP WM, Infolog is a plus.

From your STORY to ours

Qualified Applicants Will Contribute The Following

  • Bachelor's degree is required in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Management, Supply Chain Management, Logistics / Operations Management, or related field.
  • Preferred Blue Yonder WMS Technical Accreditation/certified.
  • 3+ years Strong Technical Experience in Blue Yonder Warehouse Management System is required.
  • Hands-on BY Warehouse Management process and integration with SAP ECC System (application and configuration) for global project implementations; food industry experience preferred.
  • Ensure Warehouse Process business requirements across Supply Chain Area and related functions are translated into detailed functional specifications.
  • Configure and test system processes; troubleshoot, document, and resolve system-related issues.

Certifications and specific knowledge

  • Knowledge of Blue Yonder Warehouse Management Processes is required.
  • Knowledge of Blue Yonder WM inbound, outbound, internal warehouse process and integration with transportation, manufacturing and SAP ECC system is required.
  • Knowledge of integration points and techniques with SAP system and logistics, as well as 3rd party applications is required.
  • Knowledge of integration points with SAP modules such as Invenorty Management, Procurement, Sales and Transportation planning are required.

At Lactalis, we offer a comprehensive Total Rewards Program with a variety of affordable benefits and coverage options. We support insurance costs significantly, contribute generously to retirement plans, and offer Paid Time Off from day one. We are committed to your professional growth, providing training and development opportunities, including Education Reimbursement. Join us and grow your career.

jobs.title: UPS Night Sort Warehouse Associate
jobs.description:
Role Based in West Chicago

Role Essentials

  • Job Title: Night Sort Warehouse Associate (Flexible Hours in West Chicago)
  • Location: West Chicago, IL
  • Hiring: UPS
  • This West Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in customer service.
  • Our UPS team in West Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in West Chicago, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Earnings: $23-$27/Hour (approx. $26.7k/Year)
  • Benefits: Employee discounts and perks (where applicable).
  • Excellent work-life balance in West Chicago.

Responsibilities

  • Apply your your professional skills skills in a flexible West Chicago environment.

About UPS & Our Culture

While most of the city powers down for the night, UPS powers up. The night sort is the highest-volume, highest-urgency shift in our entire package center operation — the window where the day's accumulated commercial and residential pickups are sorted and loaded onto linehaul trailers that must depart on hard schedules before dawn. If you are a night owl searching for UPS warehouse jobs that pair serious overnight pay differentials with the intensity of a world-class sort operation, our night sort shift is the most financially rewarding entry-level window in our entire logistics careers portfolio.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"The night sort is not for people who want to ease into their shift — it is full speed from the moment the belt starts. But the overnight differential genuinely adds up to a paycheck that beats every comparable warehouse job in this area. I am home by 3 AM, my days are completely free, and the Earn & Learn program is funding my degree while I sleep. UPS night sort is the best-kept secret in the local job market." - Current Night Sort Warehouse Associate, Philadelphia, PA.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Night Sort Warehouse Associate, you process the facility's peak nightly commercial pickup volume during the late-night sort window, working at sustained high intensity to clear the sort floor before hard linehaul trailer departure deadlines inside our package center.

  • High-Volume Commercial Sort Processing: Sort the dense volume of business pickup packages collected by UPS drivers throughout the afternoon, reading destination labels and routing every parcel accurately to its correct outbound trailer lane at peak belt speed.
  • Linehaul Trailer Loading: Load completed outbound pallets and loose packages onto 53-foot linehaul trailers under hard departure window constraints, maximizing trailer cube while maintaining load quality standards that prevent damage during long-distance transport.
  • Departure Deadline Compliance: Work with precise awareness of each trailer's hard departure time, prioritizing the loading sequence to ensure every linehaul trailer is sealed, documented, and released to the yard before its scheduled pull time.

Benefits & Perks

Night Sort Warehouse Associates earn a substantial overnight shift differential on top of the Teamsters base hourly wage — one of the highest total hourly rates available at the entry level across all warehouse jobs in the UPS network. Full Teamsters medical, dental, vision, pension, UPS Earn & Learn tuition funding, and paid personal time are included from day one of eligibility.

jobs.title: Chicago Full-time Overnight Warehouse Associate | Hiring
jobs.description:
Local Job Overview: Chicago

Job Title: Overnight Warehouse Associate (Gig/Contract) Hiring Organization: Amazon Based in: Chicago, IL (our growing Chicago office)

Compensation: $21-$25/Hour (approx. $48.4k/Year) Benefits: This role offers competitive pay. Set your own schedule.

Day-to-Day

Core objectives involve your professional skills in Logistics.

  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our Amazon team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Logistics industry.

Rule the Night, Fuel the Morning

While the rest of the city sleeps, the Amazon network kicks into its highest gear. The night shift is the undisputed powerhouse of our distribution model. Everything accomplished overnight determines the success of the delivery fleet the following morning. If you are a dedicated night owl seeking highly lucrative Amazon warehouse jobs with less congestion and massive earning potential, the Overnight Warehouse Associate role is your perfect entry into thriving logistics careers.

Why the Graveyard Shift Dominates

Working the overnight shift (typically 6:00 PM to 4:30 AM or similar) offers distinct lifestyle advantages. Your commute is entirely devoid of rush-hour traffic. The warehouse floor, free from daytime administrative tours, feels more focused and tightly knit. The camaraderie among the night crew is legendary within the company. Most importantly, you are financially rewarded for your hours with substantial "shift differentials" added directly to your base hourly wage.

Core Nightly Objectives

  1. High-Octane Order Processing: Your primary directive is to clear the digital backlog of orders placed during the evening. You will heavily engage in rapid picking and packing operations to ensure all parcels hit the loading dock before the critical dawn dispatch deadlines.
  2. Sortation and Palletizing: You will sort the completed, labeled packages by their final zip codes, meticulously stacking them onto pallets and wrapping them securely for the local delivery stations that dispatch at sunrise.
  3. Facility Reset and Staging: In the final hours of your shift, you will help reset the massive facility. This includes clearing cardboard debris, sweeping aisles, and fully restocking the packing stations with tape, boxes, and dunnage so the incoming day shift can hit the ground running.

Night Shift Rewards and Benefits

The financial perks of the night shift are undeniable, but they come paired with Amazon's legendary corporate benefits. You do not sacrifice quality of life for working nights. You receive the exact same Day 1 healthcare, dental, and vision insurance as daytime employees. You gain immediate access to our 401(k) matching program and the incredible Career Choice tuition coverage. If you are 18+, can lift up to 49 pounds, and thrive in the moonlight, apply today.
